title: Was That You?
text: "I was there when the turret turned. I've known you my whole life. I know how you move things. That wasn't how you move things."

choices.label: "No. Something in me that isn't me."
choices.reply: They nod slowly. "Then we watch it together. Tell me when it happens. Every time."

choices.label: "It was me. A fault. It's fixed."
choices.reply: "All right." They don't believe you. They don't say so.
